note: No numeric threshold is defined. Machine-advisory signals may only raise REVIEW and never produce ACCEPT. A criterion with evidence_class HUMAN_PERCEPTUAL can only be satisfied by a recorded human verdict on the exact output_sha256.

criteria.name: Shot file decodes and matches the planned profile

covered_by.check: ProductionQuality.validate_task_commit (dimensions, fps, frame_count, mime) compares executor-reported values with the plan; it does not open the file

FinalVideoAssemblyService re-reads each shot file and requires path under the output root, byte count and SHA-256 equal to the Core-committed evidence, and identical width/height/fps/frame_count across shots; there is no separate shot probe or decode (an undecodable shot would only fail inside the final ffmpeg concat)

criteria.proves: Each shot file is the exact file the executor committed (size and SHA-256) and the reported profile facts agree across shots.

criteria.name: Same subject/character/pet looks the same in every shot
criteria.plan_level_precondition: Every shot prompt carries the same continuity anchor. Today only per-shot continuity_keys reach the prompt (see QUALITY_ACCEPTANCE.md, G006 item 1).

criteria.name: No deformed bodies, faces, paws, hands or product geometry
criteria.mitigation_only: The fixed Wan2.2 negative prompt lists deformity terms; it reduces risk and verifies nothing.

criteria.name: Motion is physically plausible and not jittery
No flicker, texture boiling or unstable framing
criteria.advisory_machine_signal: frame-to-frame luminance variation (candidate; not implemented, not calibrated)

criteria.name: No frozen, black or duplicated segments
criteria.advisory_machine_signal: ffmpeg freezedetect / blackdetect style events (candidate; not implemented, not calibrated)

criteria.name: Shot shows the planned subject, action, framing and required facts
Cuts between shots keep lighting, scale, direction and setting coherent
criteria.fact: C004 joins shots with a single ffmpeg concat (hard cuts, no transition or color matching).

criteria.name: Beats form a coherent story with a clear hook and CTA

covered_by.check: CreativeQualityGate: schema, beat coverage, known evidence ids (structure only)

criteria.name: Factual claims are traceable to supplied evidence; nothing forbidden is emitted

covered_by.check: evidence id subset checks and contains_forbidden_output

criteria.proves: Identifiers resolve; payload contains no forbidden markers.

criteria.name: Final MP4 is the selected managed artifact, fully decodable, correct profile and runtime
Narration is intelligible, correctly pronounced and fits its timing window
criteria.proves: Audio stream properties and timing window only.

criteria.name: Captions/overlays are legible, correctly placed and do not hide the subject
criteria.proves: Overlay text hashes and artifact provenance only.

shot: BLOCKED if any criterion with on_fail BLOCKED fails, the plan task is NEEDS_HUMAN, identity fields do not match, or the existing GPU attempt cap is exhausted.

REGENERATE only when a recorded human verdict marks a HUMAN_PERCEPTUAL criterion with on_fail REGENERATE as failed AND a new bounded lineage is approved. Machine-advisory signals never produce REGENERATE.
REVIEW when any HUMAN_PERCEPTUAL criterion has no recorded verdict for this exact output_sha256, or a MACHINE_ADVISORY signal fired.
ACCEPT only when every criterion has passed and every HUMAN_PERCEPTUAL criterion has a recorded human ACCEPT for this exact output_sha256.
video: BLOCKED if any shot is BLOCKED or any machine-objective video criterion fails.

REGENERATE (partial) if the failing criteria are attributable to named shots: regenerate only those shots under a new lineage, then re-run assembly and C011 QA; the previous final artifact and receipt are not reused.
REVIEW while any shot or video-level human criterion is unreviewed. A C011 PASS receipt alone is REVIEW, never ACCEPT.
ACCEPT only when all shots are ACCEPT and all video-level human criteria carry a recorded human ACCEPT bound to the exact final artifact sha256.
